request.text: {"background":["easyERP is a multi-tenant ERP with two deployment paths: Demo (Vercel + Neon) and Production (VPS)","DEPLOY.md documents the deployment process, required secrets, and verification steps","Three workflow files exist: deploy-demo.yml (Vercel+Neon), deploy-vps.yml (VPS), ci.yml (CI gates)","Key infrastructure: apps/api/vercel.json, infra/caddy/Caddyfile, ops/systemd/*.service, ops/src/deploy.ts, ops/src/backup.sh"],"constraints":["Focus on deployment workflow correctness, security, and maintainability","Check for drift between documentation and implementation","Identify any hardcoded values that should be configurable","Verify secrets handling and environment variable management","Check for race conditions, idempotency issues, and failure modes"],"deliverable":"A comprehensive review report covering: 1) Consistency between DEPLOY.md and actual workflows, 2) Bugs and issues in workflows, 3) Security vulnerabilities, 4) Missing pieces from documentation, 5) CI/CD best practice violations, 6) Actionable recommendations with severity","objective":"Review all deployment workflows (deploy-demo.yml, deploy-vps.yml, ci.yml) against DEPLOY.md documentation and the codebase to identify inconsistencies, bugs, security issues, missing pieces, and improvement opportunities","scope":[".github/workflows/deploy-demo.yml",".github/workflows/deploy-vps.yml",".github/workflows/ci.yml","DEPLOY.md","apps/api/vercel.json","infra/caddy/Caddyfile","ops/systemd/easyerp-api.service","ops/systemd/easyerp-web.service","ops/src/deploy.ts","ops/src/backup.sh",".github/actions/setup/action.yml"]}
